5/7 Overwhelming Choices

Bitcoin, Ethereum, Dogecoin, NFTs... The options are endless. 

🛠 Tip: Start with Bitcoin and Ethereum—they’re the foundation of crypto.

Q: What’s the history of meme coins?

It all started in 2013 with Dogecoin — a joke based on a Shiba Inu meme. But the internet loved it, and a community formed. Fast forward to today, and meme coins like Shiba Inu, PEPE, and “Internet Money Thingys” are a massive part of crypto https://t.co/UaLiPlvT3C
